name: earth_tpi_7km

support_gate.definition: achieved weight total over expected weight total: the cos(lat)-weighted fraction of the native cells falling in the pixel that carried a usable value
support_gate.thin_support_warning: A pixel passing the coverage gate on a small support fraction is a weak measurement, not a missing one. Filter on support, not on validity alone.

sign_convention: TPI = z - mean(z within the window). TPI < 0 means the cell is LOWER than its surroundings, i.e. INSIDE A BOWL (crater floor, basin, valley). TPI > 0 means a rim, ridge or peak.
